name: vscode-mcp-supergateway
description: MCP Supergateway for LM Studio and other tools

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path='dist'; const backup=path + '.stale-' + Date.now(); try { if (fs.existsSync(path)) { fs.renameSync(path, backup); } fs.rmSync(backup, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 25, retryDelay: 200 }); } catch (error) { if (fs.existsSync(path)) { try { fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 25, retryDelay: 200 }); } catch (inner) { throw inner; } } }"
